description.en: Got a tester invite? Open the invite link, tap Become a tester with the Google account we invited, then install Sales X-Ray: AI Sales Coach from Google Play.
description.hi: Tester invite mila? Invite link kholiye, jis Google account ko invite kiya hai usse Become a tester dabaiye, phir Google Play se Sales X-Ray: AI Sales Coach install kijiye.
description.mr: Tester invite aala? Invite link ughda, jya Google account la invite kelay tyane Become a tester daba, mag Google Play madhun Sales X-Ray: AI Sales Coach install kara.

say.en: Got an invite to test Sales X-Ray? Here's how to join, step by step.
say.hi: Sales X-Ray test करने का invite मिला? देखिए join कैसे करें, step by step.
say.mr: Sales X-Ray test करायचं invite आलं? बघा join कसं करायचं, step by step.

latn.hi: Sales X-Ray test karne ka invite mila? Dekhiye join kaise karein, step by step.
latn.mr: Sales X-Ray test karaycha invite aala? Bagha join kasa karaycha, step by step.

say.en: Next: installing from Google Play, and moving over from the old app.
say.hi: अगले video में: Google Play से install, और पुराने app से कैसे shift करें.
say.mr: पुढच्या video मध्ये: Google Play मधून install, आणि जुन्या app वरून कसं shift करायचं.

latn.hi: Agle video mein: Google Play se install, aur purane app se kaise shift karein.
latn.mr: Pudhchya video madhye: Google Play madhun install, aani junya app varun kasa shift karaycha.

say.en: Got a tester invite? Here's how to join.
say.hi: Tester invite मिला? देखिए कैसे join करें.
say.mr: Tester invite आलं? बघा कसं join करायचं.

latn.hi: Tester invite mila? Dekhiye kaise join karein.
latn.mr: Tester invite aala? Bagha kasa join karaycha.

say.en: Open the tester invite link we sent you, on your Android phone.
say.hi: जो tester invite link हमने भेजा है, उसे अपने Android phone पे खोलिए.
say.mr: आम्ही पाठवलेली tester invite link तुमच्या Android phone वर उघडा.

latn.hi: Jo tester invite link humne bheja hai, use apne Android phone pe kholiye.
latn.mr: Aamhi pathavleli tester invite link tumchya Android phone var ughda.

say.en: Make sure you're signed in with the Google account we invited. Then tap Become a tester.
say.hi: ध्यान रखिए, वही Google account हो जिसे हमने invite किया है. फिर Become a tester दबाइए.
say.mr: लक्षात ठेवा, तोच Google account असावा ज्याला आम्ही invite केलंय. मग Become a tester दाबा.

latn.hi: Dhyaan rakhiye, wahi Google account ho jise humne invite kiya hai. Phir Become a tester dabaiye.
latn.mr: Lakshat theva, toch Google account asava jyala aamhi invite kelay. Mag Become a tester daba.

title.en: Find the app on Google Play

say.en: Now open the Google Play link on that page, or search Google Play for Sales X-Ray: AI Sales Coach.
say.hi: अब उसी page पे Google Play link खोलिए, या Google Play में Sales X-Ray: AI Sales Coach search कीजिए.
say.mr: आता त्याच page वरची Google Play link उघडा, किंवा Google Play मध्ये Sales X-Ray: AI Sales Coach search करा.

latn.hi: Ab usi page pe Google Play link kholiye, ya Google Play mein Sales X-Ray: AI Sales Coach search kijiye.
latn.mr: Aata tyach page varchi Google Play link ughda, kinva Google Play madhye Sales X-Ray: AI Sales Coach search kara.

say.en: Tap Install. As a tester, you get every new version first, through normal Play updates.
say.hi: Install दबाइए. Tester होने के नाते हर नया version आपको सबसे पहले मिलेगा, Play के normal updates से.
say.mr: Install दाबा. Tester म्हणून प्रत्येक नवीन version तुम्हाला सगळ्यात आधी मिळेल, Play च्या normal updates मधून.

latn.hi: Install dabaiye. Tester hone ke naate har naya version aapko sabse pehle milega, Play ke normal updates se.
latn.mr: Install daba. Tester mhanun pratyek navin version tumhala saglyat aadhi milel, Play chya normal updates madhun.

say.en: Already using Sales X-Ray on the web? Settings, Phone and alerts, has the same Google Play link.
say.hi: Web पे पहले से Sales X-Ray use कर रहे हैं? Settings में, Phone and alerts के अंदर, यही Google Play link है.
say.mr: Web वर आधीच Sales X-Ray वापरताय? Settings मध्ये, Phone and alerts मध्ये, हीच Google Play link आहे.

latn.hi: Web pe pehle se Sales X-Ray use kar rahe hain? Settings mein, Phone and alerts ke andar, yahi Google Play link hai.
latn.mr: Web var aadhich Sales X-Ray vapartay? Settings madhye, Phone and alerts madhye, hich Google Play link aahe.
